rows.text: La inyección diésel también puede controlarse electrónicamente: la unidad de control gestiona los inyectores y la cantidad de combustible.
evidence: Bosch, Modern diesel injection systems, Common Rail e Unit injector system, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/sg/services_and_support_6/downloads_18/diesel_system_components.pdf — sistemi Diesel a controllo elettronico.

rows.text: Los inyectores bomba pueden tener control electrónico de la inyección, aunque el bombeo sea accionado mecánicamente por la distribución.
evidence: Bosch, Diesel fuel-injection systems: An overview, Unit-injector system, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_ve_pumps.pdf — gruppo pompa-iniettore azionato da camma; Bosch, Modern diesel injection systems, Unit injector system, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/sg/services_and_support_6/downloads_18/diesel_system_components.pdf — controllo elettronico.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca FALSO, pero eso no excluye que inyectores defectuosos o mal ajustados causen funcionamiento irregular y tirones que reduzcan el confort. No todos los fallos producen los mismos síntomas.
evidence: Official superiori question 29334 prints FALSO. Delphi https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/gasoline-fuel-systems/fuel-injection-system/petrol-fuel-injection/best-practice-advice-for-servicing-common-rail-injectors describes faulty common-rail injectors causing surging; comfort effect is a practical inference, not proof every fault has that symptom.

rows.text: Una luz verde suele indicar una función activa; no identifica un desajuste de los inyectores. Una falla de gestión del motor puede indicarse con una luz ámbar y requiere diagnóstico.
evidence: Volkswagen, Car Warning Lights e Diesel Engine Management Warning Light, https://www.volkswagen.co.uk/en/owners-and-services/my-car/warning-light.html e https://www.volkswagen.co.uk/en/owners-and-services/my-car/warning-light/diesel-engine-management-lamp.html — verde per sistemi attivi; ambra per gestione motore.

rows.text: Bajar con el motor apagado no es un procedimiento para limpiar ni ajustar los inyectores. Hay que identificar la falla y actuar con equipos adecuados.
evidence: Bosch Diesel Service, Diesel Component Testing & Repair, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/afr/en/services/workshop-concepts/bosch-diesel-service/ — prova e riparazione professionale dei componenti Diesel; Delphi, Best practice advice for servicing Common Rail injectors, https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/gasoline-fuel-systems/fuel-injection-system/petrol-fuel-injection/best-practice-advice-for-servicing-common-rail-injectors — diagnosi e pulizia con kit dedicato.

rows.text: El sistema de inyección dosifica el combustible según la demanda del conductor y las condiciones del motor, no mediante una perilla del tablero.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — regolatore e cremagliera dosano il carburante; Bosch, Modern diesel injection systems, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/sg/services_and_support_6/downloads_18/diesel_system_components.pdf — gestione elettronica degli iniettori.

rows.text: Mantener el acelerador a fondo en punto muerto no es un procedimiento para limpiar ni ajustar los inyectores. La falla debe diagnosticarse y tratarse con herramientas adecuadas.
evidence: Bosch Diesel Service, Diesel Component Testing & Repair, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/afr/en/services/workshop-concepts/bosch-diesel-service/ — prova e riparazione dei componenti; Delphi, Best practice advice for servicing Common Rail injectors, https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/gasoline-fuel-systems/fuel-injection-system/petrol-fuel-injection/best-practice-advice-for-servicing-common-rail-injectors — pulizia con kit specifico.

rows.text: La bomba en línea dosifica y comprime el diésel y lo envía a los inyectores por tuberías de alta presión.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — elementi pompanti e collegamenti ad alta pressione agli iniettori.

rows.text: En una bomba mecánica, la demanda del acelerador actúa sobre el mando del regulador, que cambia la posición de la cremallera y, por tanto, la dosis enviada a los inyectores.
evidence: Bosch, Governors for In-line Injection Pumps, Fuel-delivery regulation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Bosch-Governors-for-Inline-Injection-Pumps.pdf — leva di comando, regolatore e cremagliera modificano la mandata.

rows.text: La entrega debe comenzar en el momento correcto del ciclo del motor; un dispositivo de avance puede variar su inicio según el régimen.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — sincronizzazione della pompa e dispositivo di anticipo, se previsto.

rows.text: En la bomba en línea, cada cilindro del motor tiene su propio elemento de bombeo conectado a su inyector.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — un elemento pompante e una linea ad alta pressione per cilindro.

rows.text: En la bomba en línea Bosch PE, un árbol de levas interno mueve los elementos de bombeo. Otros diseños pueden usar levas del árbol del motor; depende del sistema.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — albero a camme interno e azionamento degli elementi.

Volvo Penta marine workshop manual https://j109.org/docs/volvo_d1-30_workshop_manual.pdf p.48: another inline pump arrangement is actuated by the engine camshaft; marine example, not specific evidence for road vehicles.

rows.text: En la bomba mecánica, la demanda del acelerador pasa por el regulador a la cremallera, que gira los émbolos de bombeo y cambia la dosis.
evidence: Bosch, Governors for In-line Injection Pumps, Fuel-delivery regulation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Bosch-Governors-for-Inline-Injection-Pumps.pdf — comando del regolatore e asta dentata regolano la mandata.

rows.text: El regulador ajusta la cantidad de diésel para controlar el régimen del motor incluso cuando cambia la carga.
evidence: Bosch, Governors for In-line Injection Pumps, Introduction, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Bosch-Governors-for-Inline-Injection-Pumps.pdf — regolatore modifica la dose per regolare i giri.

rows.text: En el sistema considerado, el dispositivo de avance automático adapta el inicio de la entrega al régimen; la bomba sigue dosificando el diésel.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — dispositivo di anticipo, ove previsto, varia l’inizio della mandata in funzione dei giri; la presenza dipende dal sistema.

rows.text: En un sistema con bomba en línea, una bomba de alimentación lleva el diésel del tanque a la bomba de inyección, que lo dosifica y lo envía a alta presión a los inyectores.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — pompa di alimentazione dal serbatoio e linee ad alta pressione.

rows.text: La bomba de inyección envía diésel a los inyectores, no aceite a las piezas del motor. La lubricación corresponde al circuito de aceite.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — percorso gasolio; Bosch, Bosch pump elements, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/services/downloads/parts_14/diesel_spare_parts/diesel_spare_parts_brochurerreworked_en_91975.pdf — la pompa in linea è lubrificata dal circuito olio motore.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca FALSO. Algunas bombas en línea tienen su propio árbol de levas sincronizado con el motor; otros diseños son accionados directamente por el árbol de levas del motor. Depende del sistema.
evidence: Official superiori question 29349 prints FALSO. Bosch PE https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf pp.16–17 describes pump camshaft; Volvo Penta https://j109.org/docs/volvo_d1-30_workshop_manual.pdf p.48 describes engine-camshaft actuation in a marine engine, not proof of a specific road-vehicle installation.

rows.text: La bomba de inyección pertenece al circuito de combustible y alimenta los inyectores; no hace circular el refrigerante.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — pompa collegata alle tubazioni del gasolio e agli iniettori.

rows.text: La bomba en línea tiene un elemento de bombeo por cilindro, no uno solo para todo el motor.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — un elemento pompante per cilindro.

rows.text: La bomba de inyección presuriza el diésel destinado a los inyectores; no alimenta el circuito de frenos.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — mandata di carburante agli iniettori mediante linee ad alta pressione.

rows.text: No existe una sustitución general de la bomba en línea cada 25.000 km: se siguen las indicaciones del fabricante y se diagnostica cualquier posible falla.
evidence: Bosch, Bosch pump elements, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/services/downloads/parts_14/diesel_spare_parts/diesel_spare_parts_brochurerreworked_en_91975.pdf — manutenzione e controllo dei pompanti, durata prevista di centinaia di migliaia di miglia; Bosch Diesel Service, Diesel Component Testing & Repair, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/afr/en/services/workshop-concepts/bosch-diesel-service/ — verifica e riparazione secondo necessità.

rows.text: Las bujías de precalentamiento ayudan a calentar la cámara de combustión para el arranque en frío; no son componentes de la bomba de inyección.
evidence: NGK https://www.ngkntk.com/products/glow-plugs/ : glow plugs heat the combustion area for diesel starting. Bosch PE https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf : inline injection-pump components.

rows.text: En la bomba Bosch PE, las levas del árbol interno empujan los émbolos y los resortes los devuelven. Otros diseños usan levas del árbol del motor.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — albero a camme, punterie e ritorno a molla.

Volvo Penta marine workshop manual https://j109.org/docs/volvo_d1-30_workshop_manual.pdf p.48: another inline pump arrangement is actuated by the engine camshaft; marine example, not specific evidence for road vehicles.

rows.text: Cada cilindro cuenta con su propio elemento de bombeo, por lo que el número de elementos corresponde al de cilindros.
evidence: Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, Design and construction and Method of operation, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — un gruppo pistoncino-cilindretto per ogni cilindro.

review.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_author
reviewer_evidence: NGK https://www.ngkntk.com/products/glow-plugs/ independently inspected. Bosch PE indexed text describes internal camshaft; Volvo Penta marine workshop PDF page 24, printed 22, describes inline pump operated by engine camshaft. Live Bosch PE PDF returned 3 pages; indexed construction section was inspected independently.

issues.reason: Il quesito attribuisce FALSO al peggior comfort di marcia causato da iniettori sregolati; le fonti tecniche indicano funzionamento irregolare e oscillazioni del motore per difetti di alimentazione degli iniettori, senza delimitare in modo sufficiente il significato di comfort di marcia per conciliare la risposta stampata. Occorre accertare il criterio tecnico inteso dal quesito.
checked_sources: Delphi, Best practice advice for servicing Common Rail injectors, https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/gasoline-fuel-systems/fuel-injection-system/petrol-fuel-injection/best-practice-advice-for-servicing-common-rail-injectors — alimentazione insufficiente può causare minimo irregolare e un iniettore difettoso può causare oscillazioni del motore.

issues.reason: Il quesito esclude senza qualifiche che la pompa in linea prenda movimento dagli alberi della distribuzione. Un manuale del costruttore descrive una pompa in linea azionata dalle camme dell’albero del motore, mentre altre pompe hanno un albero proprio azionato dal motore; non è chiaro se il quesito intenda solo queste ultime.
checked_sources: Volvo Penta, Workshop Manual D1-30, fuel system, https://j109.org/docs/volvo_d1-30_workshop_manual.pdf — pompa in linea flangiata azionata direttamente dalle camme dell’albero del motore.
Bosch, PE standard in-line fuel-injection pumps, https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf — la pompa PE standard ha un proprio albero a camme azionato dal motore.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_author
issues: 29343 and 29355: The explanations treat an internal pump camshaft as universal for all inline pumps, contradicting 29349. The Bosch PE example has its own shaft, but the Volvo Penta manual directly describes an inline pump driven by cams on the engine camshaft. Qualify as the PE arrangement and acknowledge other arrangements where needed; marine example is not proof of a specific road-vehicle installation.
reviewer_evidence: Independently inspected indexed contiguous Bosch PE design section https://injectionpumps.co.uk/pdf/bosch_pe_pumps.pdf, which describes the internal camshaft and one plunger per cylinder. Live direct PDF response exposed only 3 pages, so full-section access is indexed, not live document download. Volvo Penta https://j109.org/docs/volvo_d1-30_workshop_manual.pdf PDF page 24 (printed page 22) identifies a flange-mounted inline pump actuated directly by engine camshaft; marine example.

issues.reason: The cited Bosch glow-plug brochure now returns a one-page revision notice, not the claimed technical content; replace with an accessible manufacturer reference.
